name: fr.skitribu/skitribu
title: SkiTribu – shared private ski lessons in France
description: Find or start a group to share a private ski or snowboard instructor in French ski resorts. Free.

tools.name: search_ski_lessons
tools.description: Search open SkiTribu groups ('tribes') that share a private ski or snowboard instructor in a ski resort (mostly France: Val Thorens, Les Arcs, Tignes, Chamonix, La Plagne, Courchevel, Serre Chevalier, Orcières…). Returns each group's resort, dates, level, audience (adults/children), places left and a link to join. Use it for requests like 'ski lessons in Val Thorens in February', 'private ski instructor to share', 'cours de ski collectif ou particulier à Tignes', 'cours de ski pour enfants'.

resort.description: Ski resort name, e.g. 'Val Thorens', 'Les Arcs', 'Chamonix'. Approximate spellings and nicknames work ('valtho', 'les 2 alpes', 'val d isere'). Optional.

audience.description: Lessons for adults or children. Optional.

level.description: Level code. Adults: debutant, classe1 (green/blue runs), classe2 (parallel on blue), classe3 (red runs), expert. Children (groups named after French ski school medals): ourson, flocon, etoile1, etoile2, etoile3, bronze, argent, or, competition. Snowboard: surf_debutant, surf1, surf2, surf3, surf_expert, surf_freestyle. Optional.

date_from.description: First day of the stay, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

date_to.description: Last day of the stay, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

tools.name: list_ski_resorts
tools.description: Find French ski resorts by name, region or massif (e.g. 'Savoie', 'Pyrénées', 'Alpes du Sud', 'Arcs'), with their ski schools (ESF, ESI and others), the number of open SkiTribu groups and the resort page link.

query.description: Resort, department or massif name. Leave empty for the most popular resorts.

tools.name: get_tribe
tools.description: Details of one SkiTribu group from its link or slug (the part after /tribus/): resort, school, level, all lesson dates, places left, deadline.

tools.name: create_tribe_link
tools.description: When no group matches, build a SkiTribu link that opens the 'create my tribe' form already filled with the resort, sport, level and dates. Creating a group is free; the user becomes the group leader and chooses who joins.

tools.name: how_skitribu_works
tools.description: Explains SkiTribu: free connection service, groups of 1 to 6 people of the same level, level quiz, leader approval, each person pays their share to the ski school.
